guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Fund a Solana Wallet with USDC
guide.description: Huma 2.0 settles in USDC on Solana, so you will need both in a Solana wallet such as Phantom or Solflare. You can buy USDC and SOL on Binance and withdraw to your wallet, or move existing funds across chains using the bridge widget below. Keep a small amount of SOL on hand for transaction fees. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Huma App
guide.description: Open the official Huma Finance application and connect your Solana wallet. Huma 2.0 is permissionless and requires no KYC, so you can move straight to depositing once connected.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Choose Your Farming Strategy
guide.description: Open the Deposit section and pick the mode that fits your goal: Classic : Earns real yield (around 10.5% APY, updated monthly) plus a base rate of Feathers. Best if you want returns alongside airdrop points. Maxi : Earns 0% APY but generates up to 5x the Feathers of Classic mode. Best if you are optimizing purely for allocation.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Deposit USDC and Receive PST
guide.description: Enter your deposit amount and confirm the transaction. In return you receive $PST, a liquid LP token that represents your position and accrues Feathers automatically. You can swap $PST back to USDC on Solana venues like Jupiter or Meteora to exit, though unwinding early reduces the Feathers you accumulate.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Lock Your Position for Bonus Feathers
guide.description: This step is optional. Committing your deposit to a fixed 3-month or 6-month lock multiplies the Feathers you earn over that period. Only lock capital you are comfortable leaving in place, since locked positions cannot be withdrawn until the term ends.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Stake HUMA for Extra Feathers
guide.description: If you hold HUMA, staking it earns additional Feathers on top of your LP rewards, with no fixed lockup. Holding $PST while staking adds a further boost, and keeping tokens staked for six months unlocks Vanguard status. Unstake any time.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check Eligibility and Claim
guide.description: If you farmed in a completed season, head to the eligibility checker , connect your wallet, and claim your HUMA on Solana. The Season 4 checker is live now. For the next round, keep monitoring your Feathers balance in the Huma app and claim again once its snapshot is taken and the window opens.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
